name: banzai-operator-journey
description: banzai-operator-journey (ADR-042, M2.9B): the Rust state machine for the BanzAI guided operator journey (Guia→Manifest→Conformidade→Trust→Federação→Evidence Bundle→Traces). Owns step order, transition validation, per-step statuses, progress, the next recommended action, and a SAFE, injection-neutralized session-context summary for the local Qwen. Deterministic; no LLM, no network, no persistence. Builds to Node WASM (banzai-api /ask re-summarize) and web WASM (website UI).
